Welcome to 744 W 20th Street, a beautifully renovated 1907 Craftsman in San Pedro’s Vista Del Oro neighborhoodthat pairs the character of an older home with the updates that make it easier to enjoy today. Set behind a white picket fence and mature hedging, this 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom home has been extensively improved with new electrical, plumbing, windows, lighting, fixtures, wall texture and flooring. Inside, natural light fills the open living and dining areas, where a fireplace adds warmth and character, while the updated kitchen, spacious bathroom and interior laundry make thoughtful use of the home’s 752 square feet. 
Outside is where the property really separates itself. The 5,007 square foot lot includes a large, private front yard designed for low maintenance living with artificial grass, decomposed granite and pavers throughout. Alley access at the rear provides substantial off street parking with room for multiple vehicles or an RV, along with RV connections already in place and a 120 square foot slab ready for a future shed or additional storage. A detached two car garage has been partially converted, and confirmed ADU potential gives the next owner additional flexibility for living space, a home office, guest accommodations or potential rental income. The roofs on both the home and detached garage were also replaced approximately three years ago.
The location puts you close to much of what makes living in San Pedro special, including being just six blocks from the marina, with Cabrillo Beach, Point Fermin Park, the Korean Bell of Friendship, the San Pedro waterfront and downtown San Pedro all nearby. Whether you’re heading toward the water or enjoying the privacy and low maintenance outdoor space at home, this is a property that offers considerably more than its footprint suggests.

The setting is calm and tucked away, with greenery and mountain views. Residents can enjoy the community's multiple pools and spas, along with the beautifully landscaped grounds. Downtown Palm Springs, dining, shopping, attractions, Palm Springs International Airport, and freeway access are just a few minutes away. Meaningful building updates were completed in 2026 by the HOA, including exterior paint and a new roof. These improvements enhance curb appeal and reduce near-term exterior maintenance concerns. The open-concept main floor is comfortable and easy to live in. The kitchen offers generous cabinet storage, a new dishwasher, and a counter bar for everyday meals or casual entertaining. Fresh interior paint gives the home a clean, move-in-ready feel. A recently installed HVAC (air/heat) system and water heater (May 2025) support year-round comfort and help reduce interior maintenance concerns. Upstairs, two spacious bedrooms have ample closets and large windows with desert views. A full bath upstairs and a half bath downstairs keep daily living convenient for owners and guests. Please note: Palm Springs Country Club is bordered by the former golf course, now being redeveloped as Serena Park with up to 300 residential units. Grading and construction are underway on the surrounding property. This condo can work as a full time home, seasonal retreat, or investment; buyers should independently weigh how nearby new construction may affect lifestyle, views, and future market comps.

remarks: Tall Pines, River, Solitude: Your Mountain Escape in Angelus Oaks. Located just steps away from the Santa Ana River, this fully furnished, turnkey mountain cabin is ready to enjoy in every season. This retreat sits in the heart of Angelus Oaks on U.S. Forest Service land under a special-use permit, surrounded by the San Gorgonio Wilderness and crisp mountain air. A 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom escape from the day-to-day noise of city life. Step inside to an open floor plan with exposed-beam ceilings, abundant natural light, and a cozywood-burning stove. Travertine flooring with a decorative mosaic medallion entry runs throughout, and the living room offers a built-in entertainment shelf, storage cabinet, and a sleeper sofa for extra guests. The upgraded kitchen is a true standout: granite countertops, rich wood cabinetry, soft-close drawers, and a farmhouse-style stainless sink set beneath windows with a peekaboo glimpse of the river. The updated bathroom continues the craftsmanship with a custom-tiled walk-in shower and natural stone finishes. Next, French glass doors open to a bedroom retreat wrapped in windows, warm wood paneling, unique architectural details, and a built-in closet. Imagine sipping your morning coffee on the front porch to the sound of the river, then unwinding on the spacious back patio as evening settles in under a sky of stars. The flat lot and ample parking make this cabin easy to enjoy. And once you're ready to explore beyond the porch, adventure is just outside your door. Nearby are Jenks Lake and miles of hiking and biking trails, with access to Big Bear and Bear Summit. This cabin offers a true escape from city noise, tucked into one of the San Bernardino Mountains' most peaceful recreational corridors. And when it's time to head into town, local charm is never far away. Grab a bite at The Oaks Restaurant or stock up at The Country Store, both just a short drive away; everything you need for a low-key mountain weekend is close at hand. This cabin is turnkey and ready, with every detail already in place: furniture, dcor, and comforts included, plus the practical essentials of electricity and a private water tank system, so you can settle in without a second thought. Just arrive, unpack, and start experiencing the mountain life. Sellers are highly motivated; bring your best cash offer.

remarks: An extraordinary opportunity to own one of Southern California's most unique legacy properties. Encompassing approximately 68 private acres in Los Angeles County, this remarkable estate offers an exceptional combination of history, infrastructure, privacy, and limitless potential. Bordering the Angeles National Forest and the San Gabriel Mountains to the south, the property enjoys an unparalleled setting of protected natural beauty, while panoramic views extend north toward Parker Mountain, creating breathtaking vistas in every direction. Along this particular stretch of Soledad Canyon, the canyon uniquely runs east to westan uncommon orientation in Southern California. This natural corridor allows cool ocean air to flow inland through the canyon, contributing to a refreshing microclimate and enhancing the property's year-round enjoyment. As the last privately owned property bordering the Angeles National Forest along this stretch of Soledad Canyon Road, there are no roads or easements crossing the property, preserving uninterrupted views, remarkable privacy, and an extraordinary sense of seclusion rarely found in Los Angeles County. The landscape is richly populated with mature palm trees, striking cactus varieties, native manzanita, chaparral, yucca, maguey, and other indigenous high desert vegetation, creating a dramatic and authentic California landscape. At the heart of the property lies a historic gold-bearing mine, adding a rare and authentic piece of California history to this extraordinary estate. The property has also served as the backdrop for major motion pictures, television productions, and national commercial campaigns, including Westworld, the feature film Mojave, Amazon commercial productions, and numerous other entertainment projects. An established road network, three dedicated parking areas, and extensive production infrastructure have successfully accommodated large-scale film productions. A location manager familiar with the property is available upon request. Significant capital improvements further distinguish this offering, including over $500,000 invested in electrical and utility infrastructure. The property features new utility poles, transformers, fire-protected electrical lines, a new permitted main electrical service, and electrical distribution throughout the ranch. A productive 138-foot private well supplies a 10,000-gallon epoxy-coated steel storage tank, with approximately one mile of buried 2-inch PVC water lines delivering water to the residence, barns, and all permitted structures throughout the property. Additional improvements include a commercial-sized 5,000-gallon septic system, upgraded copper water lines, insulated plumbing, new ABS waste lines, upgraded fencing and gates, and extensive structural enhancements. Multiple permitted buildings provide exceptional flexibility for restoration, renovation, or reimagining. Whether envisioned as a luxury estate, equestrian ranch, private retreat, family compound, premier filming location, wellness retreat, corporate getaway, or long-term investment, the possibilities are extraordinary. Buyer to verify with Los Angeles County all information, including future development or subdivision potential. With cinematic history, significant infrastructure, a historic gold-bearing mine, extraordinary privacy, protected natural surroundings, and some of the most spectacular panoramic views in Southern California, this is a once-in-a-generation opportunity to own one of Los Angeles County's most remarkable legacy properties.

Welcome to Lakeside Resort, a private gated community, with it's own docks, clubhouse and beach, truly no other spot like it in Lake Arrowhead! Tucked down in the cove of Blue Jay Bay, this secluded neighborhood is what you have been searching for.
Have you dreamed of Lakeside living without the lakefront prices? Now is your opportunity. Located in the private enclave of Lakeside Resort Community, you’ll find this beautiful, furnished, all one level, 2023 built, three bedroom two bath modular home, just yards from the private beach and clubhouse! Upon arrival you will find 2 level parking spots and a near level entry with 4 steps to the front door. Once inside the light bright and well curated home will capture your heart. Inside you will find a primary ensuite bedroom, two additional bedrooms and a laundry area with washer and dryer, extra storage, and vaulted ceilings. Outside there are front and back Trex decking areas with ample outdoor living and dining space. In addition, there is an outdoor shed to store your lake and hiking gear. With 22 docks attached to Lakeside Resort you even have the opportunity to rent a slip and enjoy the water sports that Lake Arrowhead has to offer. Don’t pass this little gem up! Sellers are also selling their 2024 16 Suntracker Pontoon for extra $$$.

remarks: Tucked at the end of a long, private drive on 1.24 acres of mature landscape, this remarkable Mid-Century Modern residence by architect George Foy balances intimacy and openness in equal measure. Developed in 1958 by aviation pioneer Robert Bosler Sr., a friend of Amelia Earhart and colleague of Howard Hughes, the home reflects the optimism, innovation, and clean modernist sensibility of its era. As a playful expression of family life, Bosler designed the circular driveway so his young children could race go-karts around it, a distinctive feature that remains today. Thoughtfully positioned within its natural setting, the home is defined by Foy's signature post-and-beam construction, gracefully floating roof planes, and walls of glass all combining to create an extraordinary sense of lightness. Interior spaces, terraces, and mature gardens align to form seamless sightlines that dissolve the boundary between indoors and out, creating exceptional openness while preserving complete privacy. Comprehensively rebuilt and updated with the finest contemporary amenities, the residence remains true to Foy's original 1958 vision. Every enhancement honors the home's architectural integrity while elevating its comfort and livability for today. This is a rare opportunity to own an authentic George Foy designed residence, an enduring expression of California Mid-Century Modern architecture, thoughtfully reimagined for contemporary living while honoring its remarkable history and original vision. There is an additional benefit of a private nightly neighborhood patrol.

Located in desirable Montecito Heights, this custom-built 1998 residence offers approximately 2,300 square feet of generous living space, views of Downtown Los Angeles and Dodger Stadium, and exceptional flexibility for today’s homeowner. One APN with three separate addresses of 598, 600, and 600 1/2 Montecito. With five bedrooms and three bathrooms overall—including a four-bedroom, two-bath main residence and an attached permitted one-bedroom, one-bath Jr. ADU—the property is well suited for growing families, multigenerational living, extended family, guests, or supplemental rental income.  Originally constructed as a five-bedroom, three-bath home, one of the larger bedrooms and one bathroom were later converted into the Jr. ADU. The main residence continues to offer four well-sized bedrooms, including a particularly spacious bedroom on the entry level and three additional comfortable bedrooms. The generous room sizes provide living space that can be difficult to find in many newer homes.
The attached Jr. ADU offers a level of independence that distinguishes it from many similar properties. It has its own address, separate entrance, and separate water and electrical meters, allowing the homeowner and occupant to manage their utilities independently without estimating or dividing usage. This makes the space especially practical for aging parents, adult children, a live-in caregiver, long-term guests, or a tenant.
The home retains much of its original 1998 character and offers the next owner an opportunity to update the finishes gradually according to their own taste and budget. Its substantial living space, large bedrooms, views, and permitted Jr. ADU can be enjoyed while improvements are completed over time.  The unfinished additional lower-level space with separate exterior access, address, and utilities, provides further possibilities for future customization or expansion, subject to buyer investigation and applicable approvals. Construction was halted several years ago due to the owner's passing, and the space is in various stages of approvals with the City.  
Whether envisioned as a spacious primary residence, a multigenerational home, or a property offering both personal use and supplemental income, this Montecito Heights home presents a unique opportunity to create something special while benefiting from the space and flexibility already in place.
Property is ideal for BOTH a flipper as well as owner-occupier. Won't last long!
